title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under the influence of social networks, policies, information, costs, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Adoption decisions are influenced by the fraction of peers wearing masks and the strength of ties in the social network.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mask mandates and enforcement at locations affect compliance and perceived costs of non-compliance.

interactions.name: information_broadcast
interactions.description: Media sources broadcast messages that update beliefs, risk perception, and attitudes toward mask use.

interactions.name: purchase_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals acquire masks subject to inventory, price, and personal budget.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contact
interactions.description: Agents move between locations and encounter others; local norms and enforcement influence mask behavior.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Within-household interactions reinforce mask attitudes and behavior.

interactions.name: policy_feedback
interactions.description: PolicyMaker adjusts policy stringency or communication based on observed adoption levels.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step and at the end of the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days required to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: adoption_by_demographic
metrics.description: Adoption rates segmented by age, gender, or socioeconomic status.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across groups, e.g., Gini or coefficient of variation.

metrics.name: policy_impact
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to policy (difference-in-differences between mandate and recommendation scenarios).

metrics.name: media_influence_effect
metrics.description: Marginal effect of credible vs. misinformative media exposure on adoption probability.

metrics.name: supply_constraints_effect
metrics.description: Extent to which stockouts or high prices limit adoption relative to demand.
